narrative.heading: What you have been up to
narrative.text: Over the last 4 weeks you logged 8 runs totalling 66 km, averaging 16 km per week across 4 of 4 weeks. That is up 8% on the previous 4 weeks. Your longest run was 16 km. By pace, your classified running split 1% easy, 91% moderate and 8% quality.

narrative.heading: Where to push next
narrative.text: Most of your volume sits in the moderate zone. Aim to slow your easy runs until at least 70% of weekly km is genuinely easy (6:00/km or slower). Easy running you are currently at 1%, so the grey-zone moderate work is the first thing to trim. With about 26 weeks to the marathon, your long run has room to grow. Extend it gradually, by no more than 1 to 2 km a week.
